name: IgG4-Related Sialadenitis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Comprehensive Diagnostic Criteria for IgG4-Related Disease

criteria.description: Persistent enlargement of one or more salivary glands
Histopathological evidence of dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltration with IgG4-positive plasma cells (>10 per high power field) and storiform fibrosis
Imaging showing diffuse or localized swelling of salivary glands without evidence of malignancy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical gland enlargement plus histopathological confirmation with or without elevated serum IgG4
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of malignancy and other causes of salivary gland enlargement.

pathognomonic.symptomName: IgG4-positive plasma cell infiltration in salivary gland biopsy

occasional.symptomName: Pain or tenderness in salivary glands

rare.symptomName: Cranial nerve palsies due to nerve involvement
Systemic involvement with pancreatitis or retroperitoneal fibrosis

imaging: Ultrasound showing diffuse hypoechoic swelling of salivary glands
CT/MRI demonstrating gland enlargement without focal mass
PET-CT may show increased uptake in affected glands
other: Histopathology: dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate with storiform fibrosis and obliterative phlebitis
Immunostaining positive for IgG4-positive plasma cells (>40% of IgG plasma cells)

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of anti-Ro/SSA and anti-La/SSB antibodies
Absence of IgG4-positive plasma cell infiltration
B symptoms such as weight loss and night sweats

redFlags: Severe pain or tenderness in salivary glands
Systemic symptoms such as unexplained weight loss or night sweats
references: Stone JH, Zen Y, Deshpande V. IgG4-related disease. N Engl J Med. 2012 Feb 9;366(6):539-51.
Umehara H, Okazaki K, Masaki Y, et al. Comprehensive diagnostic criteria for IgG4-related disease (IgG4-RD), 2011. Mod Rheumatol. 2012 Feb;22(1):21-30.
Kamisawa T, Zen Y, Pillai S, Stone JH. IgG4-related disease. Lancet. 2015 Apr 11;385(9976):1460-71.
